Concerned by the sudden and unnatural proliferation of woodland sprouts around the lake shores, Denalan asks travelers to uproot them before they mature into hostile timberlings. The task highlights early signs that a creeping corruption is disturbing the balance of the newly grown World Tree.

Around the serene banks of Lake Al'Ameth, strange plant-like creatures known as timberlings have begun multiplying at an alarming rate. Rather than thriving in harmony with the woodland, the emerging timberling sprouts display signs of corruption from the moment they take root. Denalan, a dedicated student of nature residing beside the lake, recognizes that these sprouts are beyond healing. Left unchecked, they rapidly mature into aggressive bark-covered creatures that menace local wildlife and unwary travelers. Gathering and destroying the sprouts serves as an immediate line of defense to keep the grove clean.

While uprooting sprouts helps manage the local hazard, Denalan notes with dread just how swiftly the sprouts appear. Their unchecked proliferation is an unnatural phenomenon on Teldrassil. Rather than being an isolated infestation, the tainted sprouts are a symptom of a deeper malaise that threatens the roots and soil of the World Tree itself—a riddle Denalan and the druids of Darnassus are racing to unravel.
